'''Nia Reston''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who took on a number of humanitarian causes, usually in association with fellow Force-sensitive [[San Herrera]]. The pair were aware that the [[Almas Academy]] might accept them as students, despite their adult status, but they felt that the structured ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was not for them. Nia had jet-black hair streaked with silver.<ref name="TRW">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: The Resistance Within}}</ref>

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Nia and San were engaged in rather one-sided trading with the [[Hiironi irstat]]. They would take high-end technological goods to the [[Tarasin]] in exchange for native crafts of much lesser value. They hired laborers in [[Gadrin]] to help them transport the goods. Most of things that Nia and San took the Hiironi were things that the Tarasin did not need, but the Tarasin saw that it made Nia and San feel good to help out the "primitives," so they let it continue.<ref name="TRW" />

Nia and San were killed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when [[Len Markus]] touched them with the [[Darkstaff]] and turned them into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]].<ref name="TheEye">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Eye}}</ref>
